description_en: Verifies whether the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID and the associated Alibaba Cloud account ID are correct, and whether CIDR block conflicts exist between the instance routes and the office network IPv4 CIDR block
description_zh: 校验云企业网实例ID与所属阿里云账号ID是否正确，以及实例路由与办公网络IPv4网段是否存在网段冲突
kebab_example: aliyun ecd verify-cen --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cen-id cen-3gwy16dojz1m650000 --cidr-block 192.168.0.0/16 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyCen

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the CEN instance belongs.

If the specified CenId belongs to your Alibaba Cloud account, you do not need to configure this parameter.

If the specified CenId belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, specify the ID of that Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
云企业实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

如果配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。

如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The IPv4 CIDR block of the office network
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The verification code. If the specified CenId belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must first call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html to obtain the verification code
parameters.help_zh: 验证码。如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，必须先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html获取验证码
parameters.name: verify_code

CidrBlocks.description_en: The recommended IPv4 CIDR blocks. Three CIDR blocks are randomly recommended. This parameter is returned when `Status` is `Conflict`
CidrBlocks.description_zh: 推荐使用的IPv4网段，随机推荐三个网段。当`Status`为`Conflict`时，返回该参数

items.description_en: The recommended IPv4 CIDR blocks. Three CIDR blocks are randomly recommended. This parameter is returned when `Status` is `Conflict`
items.description_zh: 推荐使用的IPv4网段，随机推荐三个网段。当`Status`为`Conflict`时，返回该参数

RouteEntries.description_en: The list of route information contained in the CEN instance
RouteEntries.description_zh: 云企业网实例包含的路由信息列表

items.description_en: The route information contained in the CEN instance
items.description_zh: 云企业网实例包含的路由信息

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route

NextHopInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the network instance associated with the routing entry

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the route

Status.description_en: The result of the CIDR block conflict check
